messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a product decision on 'reserved quiet period' for reserved capacity overrides. Sales wants 48h notice before reducing a customer's reserved commit, with an override path for regulated accounts. Thoughts?

jorge: +1 on 48h, customers hate surprise drops. Key asks from Acme and FinCorp; they also want a fast rollback path during incidents.

sam: From infra perspective 48h is fine. Main risk is capacity fragmentation if many overrides cluster. Suggest we cap concurrent overrides per account and add a backfill policy.

meera: legal: overrides that change billing or SLA exposure require written agreement. For SOC2 customers we can allow emergency overrides with ops review but need audit record.

janet: finance: 48h ok, but we need guardrails to prevent churn gaming. Propose override cap of 2x reserved capacity for up to 72h, then automatic revert unless contract amendment. Also require billing_ack flag.

elaine: Proposed summary: - 48h quiet period before reductions - emergency override allowed with ops approval (audit trail required) - monthly override count cap = 3 per account - temporary multiplier <= 2x and duration <= 72h Does that capture it?

jorge: captures it. add telemetry flag so sales and customer success can see override history per account and reason.

sam: I'll add metrics: override_count, current_multiplier, last_override_ts. Suggest API shape for the override request so infra + SDKs can align:

```
POST /v1/customers/{id}/capacity_override
body: { "multiplier": 1.5, "duration_hours": 48, "reason": "incident" }
```

meera: add legal field: "billing_ack": true for customer-initiated overrides and require signature when multiplier > 1.5 or duration > 48h.

elaine: Action items: sam -> draft API + infra runbook; meera -> draft legal language; janet -> simulate P&L impact; jorge -> align with top-10 accounts and map exceptions. Deadline: EOD next Tue. @ops-bot pls create RFC/PR in docs repo.

ops-bot: RFC created: https://docs.internal/rex/rfcs/1234 (ops assigned: sam)

sam: ack, will PR infra changes this week.

janet: I'll run simulations and post numbers by Fri.

elaine: Thanks all :thumbsup:
